info.name: SummarizationService
info.description: Clinical Summary Service API — patient summary and encounter clinical overview endpoints.

request.description: Check service health and OpenAI API status
Generate clinical summary with minimal patient data (only required fields)
Generate clinical summary with complete patient data (all fields including lab results)
